prompt: Manage Meta ads reporting and campaign status, and handle Facebook Page inbox workflows including reading conversations and sending private replies or bulk follow-up messages.

results.use_case: Manage Meta ads reporting and campaign status, and handle Facebook Page inbox workflows including reading conversations and sending private replies or bulk follow-up messages.
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Choose the Page to manage using FACEBOOK_LIST_MANAGED_PAGES (capture page_id; follow paging cursors/next if present).
[Required] [Step]: Review recent Page feed items using FACEBOOK_GET_PAGE_POSTS (capture post_id; paginate; an empty data list is a valid “nothing new” outcome).
[Optional (if you need thread context to moderate or reply)] [Next Step]: Load a post’s discussion using FACEBOOK_GET_COMMENTS (capture comment_id; paginate large threads).
[Optional (if posting a public reply; confirm before publishing)] [Step]: Reply on the correct post/comment using FACEBOOK_CREATE_COMMENT (use post_id or parent comment_id).
[Required] [Step]: Triage inbox threads using FACEBOOK_GET_PAGE_CONVERSATIONS (capture conversation_id; paginate; empty data can be valid).
[Optional (if you need context before responding)] [Next Step]: Retrieve thread history using FACEBOOK_GET_CONVERSATION_MESSAGES (provide page_id + conversation_id; follow paging.next if present).
[Optional (if sending a private reply; confirm before sending)] [Step]: Respond in the thread using FACEBOOK_SEND_MESSAGE (keep concise and relevant).
[Optional (if publishing a new image post; confirm before publishing)] [Step]: Publish an image post using FACEBOOK_CREATE_PHOTO_POST (use a directly reachable image reference plus caption/text).
[Fallback (if FACEBOOK_CREATE_PHOTO_POST fails due to media/format issues; confirm before publishing)] [Fallback]: Publish a text/link post using FACEBOOK_CREATE_POST.
known_pitfalls: [FACEBOOK_LIST_MANAGED_PAGES] Responses may include sensitive fields and paging cursor strings; treat tokens/cursors as secrets and opaque values.
[FACEBOOK_GET_PAGE_POSTS] Engagement totals may be nested under summary fields; don’t assume flat counters when summarizing.
[FACEBOOK_GET_PAGE_CONVERSATIONS] Participant metadata can include end-user identifiers; avoid storing or returning raw participant fields.
[FACEBOOK_GET_CONVERSATION_MESSAGES] Validation can fail if page_id is omitted; always supply page_id with conversation_id and treat paging.next as opaque.
[FACEBOOK_CREATE_PHOTO_POST] Can fail if the media reference isn’t a direct image response (e.g., redirects/HTML); requesting too many fields can cause oversized or truncated responses.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Facebook is a social media and advertising platform used by individuals and businesses to connect, share content, and promote products or services. Only supports Facebook Pages, not Facebook Personal accounts.
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=facebook. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="facebook") to create a connection BEFORE executing any facebook tools.

FACEBOOK_LIST_MANAGED_PAGES.description: Retrieves a list of Facebook Pages that the user manages (not personal profiles), including page details, access tokens, and tasks. Requires `pages_show_list` or `pages_read_engagement` OAuth scopes; missing scopes silently return empty results rather than an error. An empty `data` array means the user manages no Pages. Results are paginated via `paging.cursors`; follow `paging.next` until absent to retrieve all Pages when count exceeds `limit`. Graph API throttling (error codes 4, 17, 613) can occur during pagination — use exponential backoff.

after.description: Cursor string for forward pagination. Use the 'after' cursor from a previous response's paging.cursors.after field to retrieve the next page of results.

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to retrieve per request.

before.description: Cursor string for backward pagination. Use the 'before' cursor from a previous response's paging.cursors.before field to retrieve the previous page of results.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return for each managed page.

user_id.description: The ID of the user whose managed pages to retrieve. Defaults to 'me' for current user.

FACEBOOK_GET_PAGE_POSTS.description: Retrieves posts from a Facebook Page. Endpoint choice: Uses /{page_id}/feed instead of /posts or /published_posts because: - /feed returns all content on page timeline (page's posts + visitor posts + tagged posts) - /posts returns only posts created by the page itself - /published_posts returns only published posts by the page (excludes scheduled/unpublished) The /feed endpoint provides the most comprehensive view of page activity. Pagination: follow paging.cursors.after or paging.next across multiple calls until no next cursor exists. Throttling: high-volume pagination can trigger Graph API errors 4 and 613; use backoff between requests. API Version: Uses v23.0 (released May 2025). v20.0 and earlier will be deprecated by Meta. See: https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/changelog

since.description: Filter posts updated after this time. Accepts: Unix timestamp (e.g., '1705320000'), strtotime values (e.g., 'yesterday', '7 days ago', 'last week'), or datetime strings (e.g., '2024-01-15', '2024-01-15T12:00:00'). Datetime strings are automatically converted to Unix timestamps.

until.description: Filter posts updated before this time. Accepts: Unix timestamp (e.g., '1705320000'), strtotime values (e.g., 'yesterday', '7 days ago', 'last week'), or datetime strings (e.g., '2024-01-15', '2024-01-15T12:00:00'). Datetime strings are automatically converted to Unix timestamps.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return for each post. Supported fields include: id, message, created_time, updated_time, permalink_url, attachments, story, from, status_type, full_picture, shares, reactions, comments, is_hidden, is_published. For summary counts, use '.summary(true)' syntax (e.g., 'reactions.summary(true)', 'comments.summary(true)', 'likes.summary(true)'). Note: 'type', 'link', 'source', 'picture', 'name', 'caption', 'description', and 'icon' are deprecated since Graph API v3.3 and will be automatically removed if requested. Response nests engagement data: extract reactions.summary.total_count, comments.summary.total_count, and shares.count; treat missing keys as zero.

page_id.description: The ID of the Facebook Page. Can be provided as a string or number. Must be a Facebook Page ID, not a personal profile or user ID — use FACEBOOK_GET_USER_PAGES to obtain a valid Page ID.

removed_deprecated_fields.description: Internal field to track deprecated fields that were automatically removed.

FACEBOOK_GET_PAGE_CONVERSATIONS.description: Retrieves a list of conversations between users and the Page.

limit.description: Number of conversations to return (max 25) Use `paging.cursors.after` or `paging.next` from the response to paginate beyond the first page.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return for each conversation Avoid requesting heavy nested fields (e.g., embedded messages) to prevent large payloads.

page_id.description: The ID of the Facebook Page. Numeric IDs are accepted and will be converted to strings.

FACEBOOK_CREATE_POST.description: Creates a new text or link post on a Facebook Page. Requires `pages_manage_posts` permission and manage-level Page role on the target Page. For image posts use FACEBOOK_CREATE_PHOTO_POST; for video posts use FACEBOOK_CREATE_VIDEO_POST — media fields are not supported here. Returns a composite post ID in `PageID_PostID` format, required for FACEBOOK_GET_POST retrieval.

link.description: URL to include in the post

message.description: The text content of the post At least one of `message` or `link` must be non-empty; omitting both causes a validation error.

page_id.description: The numeric ID of the Facebook Page to post to. This is a numeric string (e.g., '123456789012345'). To obtain a valid page_id, use the 'Get User Pages' or 'List Managed Pages' action which returns page IDs for pages you have access to manage.

published.description: Set to true to publish immediately, false to save as draft or schedule

scheduled_publish_time.description: Unix timestamp for when the post should be published. Must be at least 10 minutes in the future. When provided, published must be false (will be auto-set to false if true). Must be Unix UTC epoch (not local time); timezone mismatches cause validation failures.

FACEBOOK_GET_CONVERSATION_MESSAGES.description: Retrieves messages from a specific conversation.
